public_rationale: The evidence cuts against a simple claim that construction broadly lacks customers: CBRE reports more than 80% preleasing in its North American sample. It also identifies a market where new supply outpaced absorption. Neither observation settles whether the overall AI buildout exceeds financially sustainable compute demand. The available series mix workloads and do not establish actual AI utilization or customer funding.
limitations: CBRE measures selected real-estate markets, not the complete AI compute market.
Contracted capacity and utilized computing capacity differ.
The North American report was published after the post but describes the selected pre-post period.
A narrower claim about current colocation availability would be easier to test than the contextual claim about the entire buildout.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: There isn't enough AI compute demand, and data centers are being overbuilt.

statement.excerpt: There is not enough demand. We are overbuilding data centers.

from_speaker: compute demand existed to justify the amount of data center capacity being built
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that the AI data-center buildout exceeds commercially supportable compute demand at the time of publication.

Because this describes an ongoing state, I use the latest completed half-year before publication: January through June 2026. This covers the operating market and construction pipeline then in place; it does not turn later demand into evidence about the earlier state.
The context includes capacity under construction and demand concentrated in the two labs. Testing only vacancy in completed buildings would therefore be incomplete.
Customer concentration or unprofitability alone does not establish excess capacity. Conversely, signed leases alone do not establish eventual utilization or ability to pay.
criteria.support_condition: Representative evidence shows installed and under-construction AI capacity materially exceeding credible paying demand, supported by utilization, vacancies, pricing, cancellations or comparable supply-and-demand measurements.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative AI-specific evidence shows that installed and under-construction capacity is matched or exceeded by credible paying demand, with utilization and pricing consistent with that finding.

This Q1 observation shows a local supply increase outpacing absorption. It supports concern about particular markets but cannot establish excess AI capacity across the overall buildout.
